title: Geometric six-operation comparison data
statement: Use the finite coefficient setup [sk-d-setup] and the actual six operations [sk-def-sf-operations] on separated finite-type schemes over its fixed algebraically closed finite-field base. Use the given exceptional adjunctions $Rf_!\dashv f^!$ on $D^b_{ctf}$ for compactifiable morphisms [def-nagata-compactifiable], with the restricted operations supplied by [thm-sf-ctf-stability]. Define geometric comparison data to consist of: membership of the actual coefficient unit $A_s$ in $D^b_{ctf}(s,A)$; objects $\omega_X$ in $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and identifications $\omega_X\simeq a_X^!A_s$, $\omega_s\simeq A_s$, and $f^!\omega_Y\simeq\omega_X$; natural isomorphisms $Rf_!\simeq Rf_*$ for proper morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism], $R(gf)_!\simeq Rg_!Rf_!$, and $R(\mathrm{id})_!\simeq\mathrm{id}$; natural shriek base-change isomorphisms $g^*Rf_!\simeq Rf'_!g'^*$ for Cartesian squares [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]; the projection-formula isomorphism $Rf_!K\otimes_A^L L\simeq Rf_!(K\otimes_A^L f^*L)$ natural for $K,L$ in the stated coefficient subcategories; and strong monoidal structures [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor] on the ambient pullbacks, preserving the signed derived braidings. The braidings are the Koszul signed swaps on K-flat representatives. This is only the comparison data; no package coherence or biduality or Kunneth--Verdier invertibility is included.
